item.title: Pioneering AI-Driven Digital Transformation: How Hemant Soni Is Transforming the Future of Telecommunications, Media, and Technology
item.description: Hemant Soni said Success comes from building systems people can rely on platforms that operate seamlessly, powering millions of lives daily

item.title: Bharti Airtel appoints Shashwat Sharma as Airtel India MD & CEO
item.description: Sharma's appointment will come into effect from January 1, 2026, the telecom firms said in an exchange filing. Currently the CEO-designate, he will assume the role for a five-year term, subject to shareholder approval, and will be designated as a key managerial personnel of the company.

item.title: India ranks first globally with 15.2 pc shareholder returns in 10 years
item.description: The report highlighted that sector rotation toward industrials, green energy, metals & mining, and technology has occurred, with these sectors leading due to PLI-led manufacturing, infrastructure investments, and scale-up of digital-led businesses.

item.title: Merry Christmas 2025: Alia Bhatt, Shaheen, Soni Razdan ring in festivities sans Ranbir, Raha; Kareena Kapoor holiday-ready
item.description: From decking up homes with Christmas trees and baking festive treats to sipping wine and dancing the night away, the countdown to the New Year has begun. Shaheen Bhatt hosted an intimate Christmas party attended by sister Alia Bhatt, mother Soni Razdan, her boyfriend and close friends.

item.title: ITA awards 2025: TV actor Shivangi Joshi pays tribute to Alia Bhatt; netizens say 'Fake it till you make it'
item.description: Alia Bhatt wore an elegant zari-bordered lehenga, paired with an ivory belted blouse designed by Anamika Khanna and styled by Rhea Kapoor. Many slammed Alia's choice of outfit and called it vulgar.

item.title: 'Salute freedom fighters, armed forces': Prez Murmu leads nation in paying tributes on Goa Liberation Day
item.description: President Droupadi Murmu took to the social media platform X and said, "On Goa Liberation Day, the nation remembers with gratitude the bravehearts who fought relentlessly to liberate Goa from colonial rule. We salute our freedom fighters and armed forces for their unwavering resolve and unflinching dedication. I wish the people of Goa a bright and prosperous future."

item.title: Indian team's satellite internet concept wins NASA's 2025 Space Apps Challenge
item.description: The Chennai-based team, Photonics Odyssey, won the Most Inspirational Award for reimagining satellite internet as a national public infrastructure rather than a private service. The project aims to reduce ground dependency and help connect more than 700 million people in India who currently lack access to broadband connectivity.

item.title: Trump signs NDAA seeking expanded military engagement with India
item.description: The law authorizes $890 billion in national security spending. It directs the United States to broaden engagement with India, including through the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, to advance a free and open Indo-Pacific region.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy S26's first major feature revealed; changes performance game
item.description: The South Korean tech giant said in its website post that the Exynos 2600, boasting the industry's first 2-nanometer gate-all-around (GAA) production technology, is currently under "mass production" status, reports Yonhap news agency.

item.title: Indian stock markets open higher amid positive global cues
item.description: The Nifty index was also higher, quoting at 25,926.90, up 104 points or 0.4 per cent. The index continues to trade within the 25,700–25,900 range, reflecting trader indecision.
